steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In August 2024, a guest on Equity Mates described Paragon Care as a provider of equipment, devices and consumables to the healthcare market, noting its range ran from therapeutic lasers for horses to a 24/7 hospital help desk.

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In August 2024, a guest on Equity Mates said medical wholesaling was highly competitive with thin margins, and argued CH2’s cost focused management used lower costs to cut customer prices, potentially creating an edge after its merger with Paragon Care.

views.text: In August 2024, a guest on Equity Mates highlighted Paragon Care’s merger with unlisted CH2, saying the combined group would be led by a management team that impressed them for its cost discipline, seen as important for performance in a thin margin industry.

steps.q: Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In August 2024, a guest on Equity Mates noted Paragon Care traded at 46 cents and had rallied strongly in recent months, adding it might be due a breather despite their positive view.
